**About The Opportunity**
-------------------------

Netrix Global is looking for a skilled **Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics** owns reporting and analytics for the Netrix Global Service Desk. This role transforms ServiceNow and contact center data into accurate, automated Power BI reporting that supports customer service reviews, SLA governance, and internal operational and financial decision-making. Working directly with customers and alongside Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, and service desk leadership, the Business Analyst ensures that the performance story Netrix tells its customers is timely, consistent, and backed by trusted data.

**How You Will Make An Impact**
-------------------------------

***Customer Service Desk Reporting***

* Produce, automate, and deliver monthly customer service reports and Netrix template service review presentations, enabling Service Delivery Managers to share them with customers during the first week of each month.
* Report SLA attainment by priority for response and resolution, including tickets opened and closed, backlog, mean time to resolve, reopened rates, escalations, and major incident activity.
* Report customer experience results, including CSAT, NPS, survey response rates, and voice-of-customer themes.
* Report contact center performance metrics, including average speed of answer, average handle time, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, and channel mix across phone, email, portal, and chat.
* Configure customer-specific views that reflect SLA targets, priority matrices, and scope defined in each customer's statement of work.
* Incorporate customer outages, changes, and environmental factors into SLA commentary to ensure performance results are explained accurately.
* Develop trend analysis, identify top contact drivers, and provide improvement recommendations to support quarterly and executive business reviews.

***Internal Operational and Financial Reporting***

* Maintain daily operational reporting, including open and aging ticket reports, daily and month-to-date SLA status, and queue health.
* Provide volume and demand analytics by hour, day, and channel to support workforce management and staffing decisions across global follow-the-sun delivery centers.
* Deliver team and queue-level KPI reporting that supports service desk leadership, Quality Assurance, and Training.
* Produce internal financial reporting by customer, including revenue, cost of goods sold, and gross margin, while ensuring internal-only data is never included in customer-facing deliverables.
* Build leadership dashboards and executive summaries for service desk and Managed Services leadership reviews
* Establish reporting baselines and dashboards for new customers during service desk onboarding, transition, and hypercare.

***Report Migration, Automation, and Modernization***

* Analyze and redesign existing Excel, SQL, and legacy reports into scalable, automated Power BI solutions.
* Replace manual and semi-automated reporting workflows with automated datasets, dashboards, and scheduled distribution through Power BI Service and paginated reports.
* Standardize KPI definitions, data definitions, and report structures across all service desk customers.
* Optimize reports for performance, scalability, usability, and reduced turnaround time.

***Data Modeling, Quality, and Governance***

* Design and maintain data models using ServiceNow and contact center datasets from the consolidated SQL reporting environment.
* Perform data transformation using Power Query (M) and write efficient DAX measures.
* Validate, cleanse, and reconcile data to ensure reported figures are accurate and defensible before release.
* Implement row-level security and access controls so each customer and internal audience sees only authorized data.
* Follow data privacy, confidentiality, and governance requirements, including responsible handling of customer and employee data.
* Maintain documentation for data sources, KPI definitions, report logic, and refresh schedules.

***Customer Engagement and Delivery Partnership***

* Excellent data management, reporting, and presentation skills.
* Strong project coordination, deadline management, and follow-up capabilities.
* Effective stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills.

title: GIS Analyst I
description:
We are looking for a dependable, hands-on GIS Analyst to deliver accurate, production-ready geospatial datasets. The role is primarily focused on manual GIS compilation work which includes data capture, digitization, editing, cleaning, quality checks, and delivery, carried out per user and project requirements. You will own day-to-day GIS production tasks end to end and progressively contribute to workflow improvement and semi-automation using Python, AI assistants, and geospatial tools, as the team evolves toward cloud computing and cloud-native geospatial workflows.

  

* Perform GIS production work — digitization, feature capture, editing, attribution, georeferencing, projection management, clipping, mosaicking, format conversion, and map preparation — using industry-standard GIS desktop tools.
* Create, clean, and maintain vector and raster datasets; run geometry repair, topology, duplicate, gap/overlap, attribute, and completeness checks before every delivery.
* Interpret satellite and aerial imagery, basemaps, and reference layers to capture or validate buildings, land use, infrastructure, terrain, and other exposure-related features.
* Process to DEM, DSM, DTM, LiDAR, contours, and elevation-derived data for terrain and building-height analysis under project guidance.
* Manage large datasets in common formats: File Geodatabase, GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoTIFF, CSV, KML/KMZ, and GeoJSON.
* Follow SOPs, naming conventions, folder structures, metadata standards, and QC checklists; maintain traceability of source data and edits.
* Support semi-automation of repetitive steps using ModelBuilder, QGIS Processing Modeler, Python, ArcPy, GDAL, or related libraries.
* Leverage AI assistants such as Claude, where appropriate, to assist with coding, debugging, and developing GIS solutions, while reviewing and validating all AI-assisted output before use.
* Document methods, assumptions, data limitations, validation results, and reusable workflows clearly and professionally.

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in GIS, Geoinformatics, Geography, Remote Sensing, Geomatics, Civil/Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands-on GIS or remote-sensing experience; strong practical capability may also be considered.
* Proficiency in ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, or equivalent tools for spatial analysis, digitization, cartography, and quality control.
* Strong understanding of coordinate systems, raster/vector data, geoprocessing, geodatabases, topology validation, and data cleaning.
* Working knowledge of remote-sensing imagery, elevation data, and LiDAR products, with the ability to manage large geospatial datasets accurately.
* Basic-to-intermediate Python for GIS, familiarity with ArcPy or open-source geospatial libraries, and basic SQL skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot and modify existing scripts and automate repetitive GIS workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted scripting and prompt engineering, including validation of AI-generated code and results.

description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

  

**Business Analyst, AI**
========================

**So, what's the role all about?**
----------------------------------

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.

As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.

This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Change Management & Evangelist.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.

### **Discover and Shape Ideas**

* Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want
* Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures
* Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next
* Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee

### **Define What Gets Built**

* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork

* Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch

* Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work

description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+  

employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999,  

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event  

professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help  

them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people  

together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry  

through innovative technology that powers human connection.  

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone  

and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like  

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and  

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.  

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human  

connection.  

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At  

Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our  

DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to  

experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll  

thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering  

exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,  

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered  

collaboration, we’d love to meet you.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP\&A professional to join our team as an Senior Analyst  

II – FP\&A, supporting Marketing mini\-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization —  

spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field  

Marketing.  

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and FP\&A. You will be supporting Marketing mini\-CFO to  

drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and  

pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately  

bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working,  

what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”  

In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual  

budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketingto\-  

bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead  

conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen  

with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data  

into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.  

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate  

Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.


In This Role, You Will::
* Marketing Finance Partnership \& RI (primary focus)


o Act as support to Marketing mini\-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,  

partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and  

pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.  

o Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —  

connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.  

o Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:  

* CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
* CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
* Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)
* Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR
* Marketing ROI


o Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost  

per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.  

o Drive deep\-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content  

marketing performance.  

o Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing  

tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing  

organization.  

o Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media  

investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.  

o Support and advise on resource\-allocation decisions across marketing channels and  

geographies.  

* Bookings \& Pipeline Fluency


o Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting  

marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.  

o Partner on pipeline\-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and  

pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.  

o Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one  

consistent growth story.  

* Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Work


o Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted  

measurement frameworks.  

o Create executive\-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic  

initiatives, and present them confidently to non\-financial and senior audiences.  

o Lead or support ad\-hoc strategic projects, including M\&A / acquisition integration and costoptimization  

initiatives.  

o Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other  

analytics platforms.
Here's What You Need::
* 7–10 years of experience in FP\&A, business finance, or a related field.
* Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in


Marketing Data \& ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real  

exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.  

* Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,


channel/tactic\-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the  

business.  

* Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion


analysis, and how marketing influences bookings  

* Strong data\-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to


generate insights.  

* Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to


think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.  

* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non\-financial and senior


stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.  

* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* MBA or CFA preferred
